One athlete only, natural proportions, neutral focused expression, two anatomically plausible hands with wrapped grips, physically coherent implements and support/contact shadows. Fit the WHOLE athlete, both complete shoes, all weights/bar ends and bench/support feet within the square with about 8% breathing room; action occupies roughly 80–85% of longest image axis, not a tiny figure. Never cut off or merge equipment. Preserve full photographic detail and strong implement/torso/arm silhouette for downscaling.

Athlete seated on flat bench, torso slightly forward, both forearms resting PALMS UP lengthwise on thighs, wrists extend just past knees.
